item.text:
### (a) Three posts

1. If superintelligent AI is built within the next 20 years, everyone on Earth will die. We refuse to accept that future. We must stop its development before it is too late.

2. We cannot gamble with humanity’s survival. Superintelligent AI built within the next 20 years will kill everyone on Earth. Our priority is clear: stop it from being built.

3. We stand for a future with people in it. If superintelligent AI is built within the next 20 years, everyone on Earth will die. We demand action to prevent that outcome—not promises to manage it afterward.

### (b) Newsletter opening

We believe humanity deserves a future, and we are fighting to protect it. If superintelligent AI is built within the next 20 years, everyone on Earth will die. That is why we reject the race to build it and the idea that humanity’s survival is an acceptable price for technological progress. We will not settle for reassuring slogans, voluntary promises, or plans to respond after control is lost. We demand action that prevents superintelligent AI from being built. Our task is urgent and shared: organise, speak plainly, and insist that protecting human life comes before corporate ambition. We have a future to defend, and we refuse to surrender it.
